name: Auto Decorator
description: Analyses your layout in the editor and injects themed decoration (edge lighting, glows, halos, air deco, skyline, twinkling motes, colour triggers) in one click. Preview it first, restore it any time.

max-objects.name: Max Injected Objects
max-objects.description: Hard cap on how many objects (decoration + triggers) one Apply may create. Lowest-priority decoration (motes, details, skyline) is thinned out first. Android is additionally capped at 3500.

channel-base.name: Color Channel Base
channel-base.description: Auto Decorator uses 7 consecutive custom colour channels starting here (base .. base+6). Change this if your level already uses channels 900-906.
